title: Recall: Consume lazily and short-circuit predicates
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

fold.clue: Given values: [i32; 4], write a borrowed iter/copied/fold pipeline summing from zero with closure parameters acc and value and body acc + value.

find.clue: Given values: [i32; 4], write an iter/copied/find pipeline returning the first number greater than 4. Name the predicate parameter value and dereference it in the comparison.
